answer: Wrongful gain means gain by unlawful means of property to which the person gaining is not legally entitled; wrongful loss means the loss by unlawful means of property to which the person losing it is legally entitled.
summary_answer: Wrongful gain refers to acquiring property unlawfully that one is not entitled to, while wrongful loss refers to losing property unlawfully that one is entitled to.
detailed_answer: According to the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, 'wrongful gain' is defined as the gain of property through unlawful means to which the person gaining is not legally entitled (Section 2(36)). Conversely, 'wrongful loss' is defined as the loss of property through unlawful means to which the person losing it is legally entitled (Section 2(37)).
final_answer: Wrongful gain means gain by unlawful means of property to which the person gaining is not legally entitled; wrongful loss means the loss by unlawful means of property to which the person losing it is legally entitled.
